messages.en:
{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, have you heard
the stories{01 00 00 05 00} about {ff 00 00 06}Joan{ff 00 00 00}'s
turnips?{02 00 00 05 06}
Oh, yeah.
Duh...

{07 14 00}Ever since I was a kid,{01 00 00 0a 00} I've
loved houses surrounded by
trees.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I planted lots of trees
all around my house{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 08 00}But since they were all in
my house's shadow,{01 00 00 05 00}
they got no sun and died!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Juba lapsest saati{01 00 00 0a 00} olen
armastanud maju, mida
ümbritsevad puud.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Istutasin oma maja ümber
hulga puid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 08 00}Aga kuna nad jäid kõik maja
varju,{01 00 00 05 00} ei saanud nad
päikest ja surid!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}That huge machine in {ff 00 00 06}Tom
Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s shop{01 00 00 0a 00} talks! It
talks!
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It says stuff like "Your
point balance is..."{01 00 00 0a 00} and
"Thank you very much{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}."
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Who's the unlucky slob they
stuck inside that thing,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}See hiiglaslik masin {ff 00 00 06}Tom
Nooki{ff 00 00 00} poes{01 00 00 0a 00} räägib! See
räägib!
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ta ütleb asju nagu „Sinu
punktisaldo on..."{01 00 00 0a 00} ja
„Suur tänu{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}."
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kes on see õnnetu sell, kes
sinna masinasse toppiti,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm talking about that
moody {ff 00 00 07}white turnip lady{ff 00 00 00}.
She can be a firecracker!
{07 14 00}And she has a younger (and
calmer) sister who deals in
{ff 00 00 07}red turnips{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}The two of them can be
hard to get along with,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00} but
once you get to know them,
you can get rich quick,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma räägin sellest tujukast
{ff 00 00 07}valgete naeride emandast{ff 00 00 00}.
Ta võib olla päris äge!
{07 14 00}Ja tal on noorem (ja
rahulikum) õde, kes müüb
{ff 00 00 07}punaseid naereid{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}Nendega kahega võib olla
raske läbi saada,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00} aga kui
nad tundma õpid,
võid kiiresti rikkaks saada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}He's, like, the curator or
whatever at the {ff 00 00 08}museum{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 00 00}When you give him fish and
bugs,{01 00 00 05 00} he goes off on these
long-winded speeches.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ta on seal {ff 00 00 08}muuseumis{ff 00 00 00}
kuraator või midagi sellist.

{07 00 00}Kui annad talle kalu ja
putukaid,{01 00 00 05 00} peab ta pikki
ja venivaid kõnesid.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The other day I got this
letter from {04 0b 00}.

{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}And it had{01 00 00 0a 00} {01 00 00 0a 00}a
{04 15 00} attached
to it as a gift!
{07 19 00}Now I KNOW that crazy
animal must really, really
like me,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sain hiljuti kirja
{04 0b 00} käest.

{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ja sellele oli{01 00 00 0a 00} {01 00 00 0a 00}lisatud
{04 15 00}
kingituseks!
{07 19 00}Nüüd ma TEAN, et see hull
loom peab mind tõesti,
tõesti armastama,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!{07 00 00}
